content:
Balaji Amines Limited (BAL) stands as a prominent and established player in the Indian chemical industry, headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra, INDIA. Founded in Solapur, Maharashtra, BAL has strategically positioned itself as a leading manufacturer of aliphatic amines, derivatives, and speciality chemicals, contributing significantly to various sectors across the globe. From humble beginnings, BAL has evolved into a key supplier, consistently expanding its product portfolio and production capacity to meet the growing demands of its diverse clientele.

The company's success is rooted in its robust infrastructure, advanced technological capabilities, and commitment to quality and innovation. BAL employs cutting-edge processes to produce a wide array of amines and their derivatives, critical ingredients used in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, detergents, and water treatment, among other sectors. This comprehensive offering, coupled with a focus on sustainable manufacturing practices, has cemented BAL's reputation as a reliable and responsible partner in the chemical supply chain. With a strong presence in both domestic and international markets, Balaji Amines continues to thrive, driven by a vision to deliver exceptional products and services that cater to the evolving needs of its customers while contributing to the growth and development of the chemical industry. Their commitment to R&D and meeting stringent quality standards further bolsters their position as a leading industry contender.
